requirements.rationale:
Reconexão de Rede e Dreno FIFO de Backlog [REQ-SYS-24] [Subsistema 7] [Camada APP]
Ao restabelecer a rede, descarregar integralmente as amostras retidas no backlog de RAM para o SD na ordem estrita de chegada.
requirements.fulltext: in active_session upon wifi_reconnected the esp32_fsm shall within 10 MILLISECOND satisfy backlog_fifo_drained

semantics.description:
SCOPE: in every interval where active_session holds.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (wifi_reconnected) is true and any point in the interval where (wifi_reconnected) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (backlog_fifo_drained) must hold at some point with distance <= 10 from the trigger (i.e., at trigger, trigger+1, ..., or trigger+10). If the interval ends sooner than trigger+10, then (backlog_fifo_drained) need not hold.

Conexão Wi-Fi e Pilha TCP/IP [REQ-SYS-19] [Subsistema 6] [Camada BSW]
Durante a inicialização, validar as credenciais, conectar a interface sem fio em modo Station e obter endereço IP via DHCP através da pilha embassy-net.

Detecção de Erro de Bus-Off no TWAI [REQ-SYS-27] [Subsistema 9] [Camada BSW]
Ao detectar o código de erro crítico de saturação elétrica do TWAI, registrar atomicamente o estado de Bus-Off em até 1 ms.

TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (bus_off_error_detected) is true and any point in the interval where (bus_off_error_detected) becomes true (from false).

requirements.rationale:
Despacho por Capacidade Máxima do Lote MQTT [REQ-SYS-20] [Subsistema 6] [Camada BSW]
Ao atingir a capacidade máxima de 150 frames binários (binary_batch_full), transmitir o lote binário compactado no tópico /telemetry/S{id}/raw com prazo de execução (WCET) de até 10 ms. O despacho complementar por temporização periódica (caso a taxa de frames seja baixa e o lote não atinja 150 frames) é governado de forma independente pelo ciclo de 50 ms em REQ_COM_004.
requirements.fulltext: in connected_mode upon binary_batch_full the esp32_telemetry shall within 10 MILLISECOND satisfy mqtt_batch_published

semantics.description:
SCOPE: in every interval where connected_mode holds.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (binary_batch_full) is true and any point in the interval where (binary_batch_full) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (mqtt_batch_published) must hold at some point with distance <= 10 from the trigger (i.e., at trigger, trigger+1, ..., or trigger+10). If the interval ends sooner than trigger+10, then (mqtt_batch_published) need not hold.

SCOPE: in every interval where active_session holds.

requirements.rationale:
Rearme Periódico do Watchdog de Hardware [REQ-SYS-30] [Subsistema 9] [Camada BSW]
Enquanto as tarefas estiverem saudáveis, a tarefa supervisora deve rearmar o watchdog de hardware em intervalo inferior a 2 s (timeout de 5 s).
requirements.comments: avaliar se não tem que atualizar variavel não sei
requirements.fulltext: in active_session when system_tasks_healthy upon wdt_feed_tick the esp32_recovery shall within 1 MILLISECOND satisfy hw_watchdog_fed

semantics.description:
SCOPE: in every interval where active_session holds.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if ((system_tasks_healthy) & (wdt_feed_tick)) is true and any point in the interval where ((system_tasks_healthy) & (wdt_feed_tick)) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (hw_watchdog_fed) must hold at some point with distance <= 1 from the trigger (i.e., at trigger, trigger+1, ..., or trigger+1). If the interval ends sooner than trigger+1, then (hw_watchdog_fed) need not hold.

requirements.rationale:
Tarefa Periódica de Despacho (BSW Com) [REQ-SYS-20] [Subsistema 6] [Camada BSW]
A cada ciclo de despacho de telemetria, a camada de comunicação (`bsw_com`) deve arbitrar e despachar os lotes binários acumulados no canal MQTT sem exceder 2,5 ms de tempo de execução da CPU. No firmware em Rust , o despacho é executado pela tarefa assíncrona `task_wifi`, consumindo frames do canal estático `MQTT_TX_CHANNEL` (capacidade 500) em lotes de até 150 registros.

Intercalação de Comandos de Bancada no Transmissor [REQ-SYS-05] [Subsistema 3] [Camada APP]
Intercalar o envio de comandos CAN (ex: 0x010) entre as janelas de polling OBD sem violar a periodicidade nominal de 100 ms.

SCOPE: in every interval where active_session holds.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (can_cmd_received_in_queue) is true and any point in the interval where (can_cmd_received_in_queue) becomes true (from false).

requirements.rationale:
Captura e Marcação Temporal de Frames [REQ-SYS-03][Subsistema 2] [Camada MCAL]
Ao receber um frame físico no TWAI, registrar imediatamente o carimbo temporal do sistema em microssegundos/milissegundos.
requirements.fulltext: in active_session upon can_frame_arrived the esp32_twai shall within 2 MILLISECOND satisfy frame_timestamp_captured

semantics.description:
SCOPE: in every interval where active_session holds.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (can_frame_arrived) is true and any point in the interval where (can_frame_arrived) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (frame_timestamp_captured) must hold at some point with distance <= 2 from the trigger (i.e., at trigger, trigger+1, ..., or trigger+2). If the interval ends sooner than trigger+2, then (frame_timestamp_captured) need not hold.

requirements.rationale:
Despacho por Capacidade Máxima do Lote MQTT [REQ-SYS-20] [Subsistema 6] [Camada BSW]
Ao atingir a capacidade máxima de 150 frames binários (binary_batch_full), transmitir o lote binário compactado no tópico /telemetry/S{id}/raw com prazo de execução (WCET) de até 10 ms. O despacho complementar por temporização periódica (caso a taxa de frames seja baixa e o lote não atinja 150 frames) é governado de forma independente pelo ciclo de 50 ms em REQ_COM_004.
requirements.fulltext: in connected_mode upon binary_batch_full the esp32_telemetry shall within 10 MILLISECOND satisfy mqtt_batch_published

semantics.description:
SCOPE: in every interval where connected_mode holds.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (binary_batch_full) is true and any point in the interval where (binary_batch_full) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (mqtt_batch_published) must hold at some point with distance <= 10 from the trigger (i.e., at trigger, trigger+1, ..., or trigger+10). If the interval ends sooner than trigger+10, then (mqtt_batch_published) need not hold.

requirements.rationale:
Limite de Consumo de Memória SRAM [REQ-SYS-29 / AC-05] [Subsistema 4] [Camada APP]
O consumo de memória SRAM alocável deve permanecer estritamente contido abaixo de 200 KB durante operação contínua (Critério AC-05).
requirements.fulltext: in active_session when memory_supervision_active the esp32_logger shall always satisfy sram_usage_kb < 200.0

TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (memory_supervision_active) is true and any point in the interval where (memory_supervision_active) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (sram_usage_kb < 200.0) must hold at all time points between (and including) the trigger and the end of the interval.

requirements.rationale:
Montagem do Sistema de Arquivos FAT32 [REQ-SYS-16] [Subsistema 5] [Camada BSW]
Durante o boot, se o módulo leitor SPI estiver operacional e o cartão MicroSD estiver fisicamente inserido, o sistema deve inicializar o barramento e montar a partição FAT32 em até 500 ms, assegurando que a mídia de armazenamento esteja pronta e formatada antes do início da telemetria.
requirements.fulltext: in boot_mode upon boot_trigger & mcal_spi_sd_up & sd_card_inserted the esp32_sd shall within 10 MILLISECOND satisfy fat32_filesystem_mounted

semantics.description:
SCOPE: in every interval where boot_mode holds.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (boot_trigger & mcal_spi_sd_up & sd_card_inserted) is true and any point in the interval where (boot_trigger & mcal_spi_sd_up & sd_card_inserted) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (fat32_filesystem_mounted) must hold at some point with distance <= 10 from the trigger (i.e., at trigger, trigger+1, ..., or trigger+10). If the interval ends sooner than trigger+10, then (fat32_filesystem_mounted) need not hold.

requirements.rationale:
Rearme Periódico do Watchdog de Hardware [REQ-SYS-30] [Subsistema 9] [Camada BSW]
Enquanto as tarefas estiverem saudáveis, a tarefa supervisora deve rearmar o watchdog de hardware em intervalo inferior a 2 s (timeout de 5 s).
requirements.comments: avaliar se não tem que atualizar variavel não sei
requirements.fulltext: in active_session when system_tasks_healthy upon wdt_feed_tick the esp32_recovery shall within 1 MILLISECOND satisfy hw_watchdog_fed

semantics.description:
SCOPE: in every interval where active_session holds.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if ((system_tasks_healthy) & (wdt_feed_tick)) is true and any point in the interval where ((system_tasks_healthy) & (wdt_feed_tick)) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (hw_watchdog_fed) must hold at some point with distance <= 1 from the trigger (i.e., at trigger, trigger+1, ..., or trigger+1). If the interval ends sooner than trigger+1, then (hw_watchdog_fed) need not hold.

requirements.rationale:
Tarefa Periódica de Despacho (BSW Com) [REQ-SYS-20] [Subsistema 6] [Camada BSW]
A cada ciclo de despacho de telemetria, a camada de comunicação (`bsw_com`) deve arbitrar e despachar os lotes binários acumulados no canal MQTT sem exceder 2,5 ms de tempo de execução da CPU. No firmware em Rust , o despacho é executado pela tarefa assíncrona `task_wifi`, consumindo frames do canal estático `MQTT_TX_CHANNEL` (capacidade 500) em lotes de até 150 registros.
